marks.label: The 12 cranial nerves · Built from what you gave me | 12 stops: Olfactory, Optic, Oculomotor, Trochlear…
1 · Olfactory | The cat lifts its head to see the optic bird.
2 · Optic | The bird spots a moving eye‑muscle dog.
3 · Oculomotor | The hat spins toward the trochlear umbrella.
4 · Trochlear | A drop falls onto the trigeminal tree.
5 · Trigeminal | One ball rolls to the abducens house.
6 · Abducens | The sun shines on a smiling facial cat.
7 · Facial | The cat's star eyes hear the vestibular bird.
8 · Vestibulocochlear | A drop from the fountain drips onto the glossopharyngeal book.
9 · Glossopharyngeal | The sun lights a vagus person.
10 · Vagus | The person passes an accessory dog.
11 · Accessory | The dog runs to the hypoglossal mountain.
12 · Hypoglossal | Number 12: Hypoglossal. Picture "12" glowing beside Hypoglossal.
